description: Change a CarlNotes topic you may edit: its name, tags, visibility (public, invite, or private), how often it brews (daily, weekdays, or weekly), the time of day as HH:MM and the day a weekly brew runs, how many findings a brew keeps (5, 10, 15, or 20), the prompt every brew scores against, sources to add as option and value pairs, source ids to remove, which list_topics shows, and a team to add the topic to or take it off, which follows the team page's rules. Set isPodcastEnabled to turn the topic's Coffee Break podcast on or off. Name only what changes. Making a topic public, removing a source, or adding a topic that is not public to a team saves nothing at first: the result shows the topic as it would read and a confirmation. Ask the person, and once they agree, call again with the same edit and that confirmation. Every prompt save keeps a version, and no brew starts. Use it when the user asks Carl or CarlNotes to change a topic, with phrases like edit this topic, change the prompt, add a source, change the schedule, or add this topic to my team.

confirmation.description: The confirmation a previous call returned for this same edit, once the person agreed to it.

is_on_team.description: True adds the topic to team_id, which is the default, and false takes it off.

team_id.description: A team to add the topic to or take it off, by the id list_teams shows.

topic_id.description: The topic's id. Optional on a topic-bound server, which already knows its topic.

name: edit_topic
title: Edit a topic
